_comment: Every skip CI is allowed to have, with a reason. Checked by scripts/check-test-skips.mjs. An entry that stops skipping is an ERROR, not a warning — remove it. A value may be a reason string, or { reason, requiresEnv } — with requiresEnv, the skip is allowed only while that variable is unset, and the file MUST run when it is set.

server/src/syncCells/placementProposerHe.reason: T-14e runs the real proposer entry, ActivityWitness, authenticated HTTP metrics and signal loss/recovery against an isolated PostgreSQL schema and restricted LOGIN. CI supplies TEST_DATABASE_URL; missing fixture privileges fail setup.

server/src/syncCells/placementProposer.i.reason: T-14d exercises a real dedicated LOGIN, SQLSTATE 42501, capture metadata, concurrent transactions and uncertain COMMIT. Requires a TEST_DATABASE_URL whose fixture administrator can create/drop its isolated role; CI supplies this service. Missing privileges fail setup, never skip.

server/src/syncCells/ownership.topologyM.reason: B3i / D53 compares the durable PostgreSQL witness before real Redis creation, distinguishes created from matched, and suspends publication to exercise retries and stop. Requires both TEST_DATABASE_URL and TEST_REDIS_URL. CI supplies both; when TEST_DATABASE_URL is set, skipping this file is a failure rather than qualification.

files.src/lib/layout/portfolioReplay.test.ts: The measurement behind elkConfig.ts STRATEGIES, kept runnable behind `describe.runIf(LAYOUT_REPLAY === '1')`: it replays bestLayout's selection over every fixture view plus synthetic chains under three direction hints, once per portfolio (~10 minutes). Run it when changing the portfolio; the placement regressions that matter on every run live in placement.test.ts.

server/src/backup/backupRestore.integrat.reason: The real pg_dump/pg_restore drill. Needs the client binaries plus CREATEDB for its temporary restore database, so it stays opt-in via BACKUP_RESTORE_TEST_DATABASE_URL for a bare `npm test`. Both CI and `npm run ci:local` set it, and borrow the binaries from the Postgres container over `docker exec` (DockerPgTools) rather than depending on whatever client the host has — Windows has none, and a runner's pg_dump refuses to talk to a server newer than itself. With the variable set this entry becomes an assertion that the drill RAN.

server/src/syncCells/reconcileStatementT.reason: Task T-B4q's exit witness. It needs BOTH Postgres and Redis: the ceilings are applied by the server (statement_timeout/lock_timeout in the connection's startup packet) and a fake cannot honestly raise 55P03 on a schedule of its own choosing. WITH the variables set this entry becomes the assertion that it RAN — which matters more here than usual: a QA lens measured that reverting the whole remedy leaves every one of the 269 unit tests green, and typecheck too, because Pool is structurally a Queryable. This file is the only thing that fails.

server/src/backup/restoreDatabaseCommand.reason: Task B4-6a. Spawns the REAL `scripts/restore-database.ts` through tsx against real scratch databases and a real pg_dump/pg_restore, so it carries the same client-binary and CREATEDB needs as its two siblings and stays opt-in via BACKUP_RESTORE_TEST_DATABASE_URL for a bare `npm test`. Both CI and `npm run ci:local` set it. It has to drive the SCRIPT rather than the library: the task's second mutant is 'delete the call from restore-database.ts', and every in-process harness stays green against it.

server/src/backup/restoreRoutingReset.in.reason: R2 (task B4-6). A real pg_dump/pg_restore into a scratch database, then the routing reset, so it carries the same client-binary and CREATEDB needs as backupRestore.integration.test.ts and stays opt-in via BACKUP_RESTORE_TEST_DATABASE_URL for a bare `npm test`. Both CI and `npm run ci:local` set it. WITH the variable set this entry becomes an assertion that the reset drill RAN — which is the point: a review measured that without it the suite can skip itself into silence and nothing disagrees.

server/src/backup/coldApi.integration.te.reason: Boots a REAL server process against a real database and asks it the backup drill's four read-model questions — the one production wiring of the cold-API stage, which had no test at all (drillRunner.test.ts passes coldApi:false and coldApi.test.ts uses a fake fetch). Needs CREATEDB for its own temporary database, so it shares the drill suite's gate. With the variable set this entry becomes an assertion that the cold-API wire RAN.
